faqs.q: Can I export data to Excel?
faqs.a: Yes, in Settings > Export you can get all sow records and reports as Excel/PDF.

faqs.q: What happens to records entered offline?
faqs.a: They are saved locally and synced automatically when online. Sync status is shown at the top of the screen.

faqs.q: How is AI loss estimation calculated?
faqs.a: NPD delays, farrowing-rate drops, mortality etc. are compared to 27-year benchmarks and converted to a monetary amount.

faqs.q: Can I manage multiple farms in one account?
faqs.a: Yes, an organization account can register and switch between multiple farms.

legal.title: Terms & policy
legal.revised: Last revised 2026-06-15 · v2.4 · Draft for legal review
legal.disclaimer: This page is a draft prepared for legal review and does not constitute legal advice or a final binding agreement.

terms.b: These Terms govern the conditions, procedures, rights, and obligations for using the PigOS service operated by WiseLake (the 'Company'). This document is a draft prepared for legal review and is not a final or legally binding agreement.

'Service' means the swine farm management platform and optional AI analysis add-ons. 'Member' means a user who accepts these Terms. 'Farm Data' means herd, event, and operational records entered by the Member. 'Add-on' means an optional paid feature such as AI Insight.

Members register an account and access one or more farms through farm membership. Access is controlled by role (Owner, Manager, Worker, Viewer), and each tenant's data is isolated by farm identifier. Members are responsible for safeguarding their credentials.

terms.h: Article 4 (Plans, free service, add-ons, and billing)
terms.b: The core service is provided free of charge. Optional add-ons such as AI Insight are paid and billed on a subscription basis, exclusive of applicable taxes. The Company may change fees or plan features with prior notice, effective from the next billing cycle.
Farm Data is owned by the Member. The Member grants the Company a limited license to host and process Farm Data in order to provide the service and to generate anonymized, aggregated analytics.

terms.h: Article 6 (Data monetization, anonymization, and farmer dividend)
terms.b: The Company may create anonymized, aggregated benchmarks and commercial data products derived from Farm Data. Where such data is monetized, the Company intends to share a portion of the resulting value with participating farms (a 'data dividend'). Personal and farm-identifying information is removed before any such use.

Members must not use the service for unlawful purposes, enter knowingly false data, infringe the rights of others, attempt to reverse engineer or disrupt the service, or seek unauthorized access to other tenants' data.

The service is provided 'as is'. AI Insight outputs are advisory and do not replace professional veterinary or business advice. To the extent permitted by law, the Company's liability is limited and implied warranties are disclaimed; mandatory consumer protections remain unaffected.

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Company's principal place of business, and disputes are subject to the competent courts there, except where mandatory local law grants the Member rights in their country of residence.

A Member may terminate at any time and may export Farm Data before deletion. Upon termination, data is deleted except where retention is legally required. The Company will give notice of material changes to these Terms before they take effect.

privacy.b: Account data (name, email, phone), farm data (farm profile, herd and event records), device and log data, and optional location data when you enable it.
Directly from your input, automatically through service logs and cookies, and through the mobile app including offline entries synchronized when connectivity is restored.
To provide the service, compute KPIs and AI analysis, generate anonymized benchmarks, deliver customer support, ensure security and prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations.
We use service providers (for example cloud hosting) as processors under contract and may transfer data across borders with appropriate safeguards. We do not sell personal data.
Personal data is retained while your account is active and deleted upon withdrawal, except where a longer retention period is legally required, after which it is disposed of.
You may request access, correction, deletion, and portability, and may object to or withdraw consent for certain processing, subject to applicable law.
We use essential cookies for operation and analytics cookies to improve the service. You can control non-essential cookies through your browser or in-app settings.
We apply encryption in transit, role-based access control, audit logging, and k-anonymity (k≥10) for benchmark data so that individual farms cannot be identified.
The service is intended for agricultural businesses and is not directed to children below the age defined by applicable law; we do not knowingly collect their personal data.

privacy.h: 10. Data protection contact and regional notices
privacy.b: For privacy requests contact privacy@pigos.io. This section summarizes rights under GDPR (EU/EEA), CCPA/CPRA (California), and PIPA (Korea) for reference only; it is not a definitive statement of compliance, and specific regional terms prevail where required.

alertsMeta.rulePregnantOverdueFarrowing_impact: May indicate a missed farrowing record, abortion, or pregnancy failure — distorts farrowing rate and litter KPIs.
alertsMeta.ruleOpenOverdueMating_impact: Accrues non-productive days (NPD) — the single biggest direct driver of low PSY.
alertsMeta.ruleAccidentOverdueMating_impact: Extends the empty period after a reproductive accident, raising NPD.
alertsMeta.ruleLactatingOverdueWeaning_impact: Over-long lactation delays re-breeding and lowers sow turnover (PSY).
alertsMeta.ruleGiltOverdueMating_impact: Aging unbred gilts raise non-productive inventory and breeding cost per litter.
alertsMeta.ruleGiltNoEstrus_impact: Gilts without detected estrus delay entry into the breeding herd.
